content.short: Etherfuse is a tokenized sovereign bond and FX platform for treasuries and fintechs.
content.description: Etherfuse tokenizes sovereign bonds and provides FX rails, letting treasuries and fintechs hold yield-bearing government debt on-chain. Its focus on non-US sovereign debt is the distinguishing choice, since most tokenized bond products begin and end with US Treasuries.
content.meta: Tokenized sovereign bonds beyond US Treasuries, with FX rails for treasuries and fintechs.
